excerpts.text: China has a population of 1,412,914,088 in 2026, according to the [UN World Population Prospects 2024](https://population.un.org/wpp/) (projection for 1 July).

A UN projection for 1 July 2026 from [World Population Prospects 2024](/methodology); UN estimates end in 2023. [Download SVG](/images/pyramids/china-population-pyramid-2026.svg) — free to reuse with credit to populationpyramids.org.

**About this data:** [UN World Population Prospects 2024](https://population.un.org/wpp/), released 11 July 2024. Figures for 2024 and later are medium-variant projections for 1 July. The UN has postponed its next revision from 2026 to 2027 ([UN document E/CN.9/2026/CRP.1](https://www.un.org/development/desa/pd/sites/www.un.org.development.desa.pd/files/undesa_pd_2026_cpd59_e_cn.9_2026_crp.1.pdf)); these pages will be updated when it is published.
